live.note: the impact_sum the live hunt emitted (the book today)

sum_ge1.note: impact_sum of findings of at least 1 point

per_implied.note: impact_sum over the move the market expects

agree_runup.note: impact_sum x1.5 where it agrees with -run_up_20d, x0.5 where not

ctrl_short.note: short every name, random pick of the top share

cat_weights.note: per-category weight from train hit rate, shrunk by n

ridge_signed.note: ridge on signed features, lambda by inner leave-one-day-out

selector.note: live sign x P(sign right) from a logistic on unsigned features

rejudge_sonnet.note: blinded re-judge, sonnet, same evidence (names it did not judge are skipped)

rejudge_opus.note: blinded re-judge, opus, same evidence (names it did not judge are skipped)
